## HOW TO RECALL

| What | How | Example |
|------|-----|---------|
| Agent / Skill | Type `@` then filename | `@frontend-skills` → loads Frontend Skills |
| Workflow | Type `/` then workflow name | `/plan` → opens planning workflow |
| Any file | Type `@` → pick Files | Browse workspace files |
| Rules | Type `@` → pick Rules | Browse `.agent/rules/` |
| Terminal | Type `@` → pick Terminal | Use current terminal context |
